description: Output JSON written by gauntlet/tools/run_latte.py after driving LATTE (Eisner et al. 2020) in --targetlist batch mode. LATTE emits plots + a PDF report, NOT machine-readable per-check dispositions — so metrics carries the report location, not dispositions (see PHASE_2_PROGRESS.md, 2B judgment call 2). A completed run must carry a report PDF (if/then below): LATTE swallows per-target failures and exits 0 with no report, so a completion claim without a report is a lie.

artifacts.description: Evidence file paths — the report PDF when completed, empty otherwise.

config_hash.description: sha256 of the tool config file, echoed from the input.

input_hashes.description: Input hashes echoed from the input JSON (lightcurve + neighbours), so a cached result is verifiable.

n_artifacts.description: Files in the per-target output directory.

output_dir.description: LATTE's per-target output directory ({indir}/{tic}); null when the run never got that far.

report_pdf.description: Path to the DV report PDF copied into the run workdir; null when no report was produced.

n_transits.description: Transits the signal rests on, echoed from the input.

seed.description: Seed echoed from the input (LATTE is deterministic given its inputs; the seed is recorded for the record, not consumed by the tool).

status.description: Tool outcome: completed (a DV report was produced), failed, or timeout.

tool_version.description: Installed tessLATTE version (importlib.metadata), falling back to the input's expected version with a warning.

value.description: Null: LATTE has no scalar — a checklist has no headline number (C-10).

wall_time_s.description: Wall time of the LATTE invocation, seconds.

title: LATTE tool output (Phase 2, 2B)
